residuals.actual: Freshness expiry and transient unavailability now enter a coalesced refresh path; refreshed roles are re-branded, freshness checked, and provider-model-bound before admission. A provider-probe verifier derives READY from actual typed responses plus explicit provider capability facts.
Runtime startup and refresh reject profile/provider modelRef drift. roleBody cannot override model, messages, output limit, or structured-output mode.
native emits provider response_format, prompted uses schema instructions without native response_format, and unsupported is rejected before provider execution.
Observed modelRef, structured-output mode, contextWindow, and maxOutputTokens must independently satisfy the declared profile; lower or mismatched facts remain UNAVAILABLE.
Compatibility now binds generated JSON schemas from the runtime Zod schemas and executable refinement outcomes, detecting field/nested/enum/status/error/refinement breakage.
Pre-queue boundary/spec/payload/context rejection writes sanitized PRE_QUEUE_REJECTION structured events without payload, prompt, image bytes, or secret text.

realProviderEvidence: Existing committed REAL-PROVIDER-EVIDENCE.json remains the real-provider behavior basis; this remediation did not fabricate a new live-provider run.
